## Models
- [Mirage](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/mirage/): A compact five-door hatchback with a 1.2L MIVEC engine and a 4.6-meter turning radius, made for narrow streets, tight parking and an easy first-car budget.
- [Mirage G4](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/mirage-g4/): A compact, fuel-sipping sedan that is easy to park around SJDM and Metro Manila and gentle on a first-car budget.
- [Xpander](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/xpander/): The family MPV built around Filipino life: seven seats, high ground clearance for flooded streets, and a cabin that handles provincial trips.
- [Xpander Cross](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/xpander-cross/): Everything families like about the Xpander, with a rugged crossover look and a more premium cabin.
- [Xforce](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/xforce/): A compact SUV with bold styling and a raised driving position, sized for city streets but ready for out-of-town weekends.
- [Destinator](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/destinator/): Mitsubishi's newest 7-seat SUV, with a turbocharged 1.5L engine and a roomy, tech-forward cabin.
- [Outlander PHEV](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/outlander-phev/): Mitsubishi's plug-in hybrid SUV: drive on electricity for everyday trips and let the gasoline engine take over for long ones.
- [Montero Sport](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/montero-sport/): The full-size diesel SUV, including the Black Series. Built on a ladder frame for long drives, rough roads and heavy loads.
- [Triton](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/triton/): A tough diesel pickup that works hard on weekdays and still feels comfortable for the family on weekends.
- [L300](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/l300/): The workhorse of Philippine small businesses, available as a cab and chassis for custom bodies or as a ready-to-work dual-AC unit.
- [Versa Van](https://www.mitsubishi-sjdm.com/cars/versa-van/): A full-size diesel van for shuttle services, company transport and big families who travel together.
